note: Captured quotes, not mined transactions. Expected assets from quotes cross-checked against fixed-block metadata; minima read from calldata.

blocked.fewSemantics: SwapV2Router.swapExactTokensForTokens checks amounts[last] >= amountOutMin then unwrapTo(amounts[last], to). FewWrappedToken.unwrapTo burns amount and transfers exactly amount of token; token is set only in constructor.
blocked.curveSemantics: ethUnoswap skips WETH deposit at bit 251; _curfe bit 242 sends amount as call value when output is not ETH. Only registered pools and matching coins/indexes are accepted.
blocked.polygonCurveSemantics: Both verified CurveStableSwapNG contracts use immutable coins and exchange(int128,int128,uint256,uint256,address). _exchange checks dy >= _min_dy and transfers coin[j] to receiver.

metadata.scope: Official static plain Curve pools on existing supported chains, plus user-supplied Ethereum StableSwapNG pools with usdTotal >= 1000000, plain implementation and not marked broken. Only metadata verified against RPC and compatible exchange/coins ABI is included.
metadata.note: Constructed parser tests are not evidence of successful swap execution. API TVL was used only for selection, not as a trust or safety classification.
